correctness.rationale: Full 3-deck compresses to four invariants (z,U,V,Q). Equal z,U,V implies zero-gap difference (-t,3t,-3t,t) and Q equality forces c-b=3t, giving unique involutive collision partner and no classes of size above two. Orienting b<c counts one pair for each t≥1,u,b,d≥0, z=4t+u+2b+d, proving generating function x^4/((1-x)^2(1-x^2)(1-x^4)). Independent literal subsequence counting for z=0..9 reproduced Pz=0,0,0,0,1,2,4,6,10,14. Infinite result follows algebraically.
